notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {B} or {R}.
Cast Disturbed Burial for its buyback cost by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist for {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of artifacts and enchantments your opponent control.
Activate six of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{R}.
Repeat.
